name: soul-mate-v2
description: Soul Mate v2: Electron/Vue frontend, Node.js backend, Rust Agent sidecar and N-API embedding kernel.

scripts.build:rust: npm run build:rust-agent && npm run build:rust-napi && npm run build:rust-mcp
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:rust && npm run build -w @soul-mate/agent-contracts && npm run build -w @soul-mate/agent-ts && npm run build -w @soul-mate/backend
scripts.build:package-deps: npm run build:backend && npm run build:vision-opencv
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build -w soul-mate-frontend
scripts.build:release: npm run build:package-deps && npm run build -w soul-mate-frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @soul-mate/agent-contracts && npm run build -w @soul-mate/agent-ts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:rust: cargo test --manifest-path packages/embedding-core/Cargo.toml --target-dir .cargo-target && cargo test --manifest-path packages/embedding-napi/Cargo.toml --target-dir .cargo-target && cargo test --manifest-path packages/mcp-rust/Cargo.toml --target-dir .cargo-target && cargo test --manifest-path packages/agent-rust/Cargo.toml --target-dir .cargo-target
